entities.name: Ramunap
entities.description: Desolate wilderness beyond the Shefet dunes around Naktamun on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: Only known settlement on Amonkhet, where the gods dwelled.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Ruler of Amonkhet whose return the gods awaited.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon whose departure left Monarchs unquiet.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: Force whose approach is heralded by dark signs.

entities.name: Tombs Before Time
entities.description: Vast region where ancient Monarchs sit on dusty thrones.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: Race whose fourth stage crosses the Broken Lands.

events.summary: The living learned the Broken Lands are meant to be healed, and volunteers set out from Naktamun.
events.quote: the Broken Lands are not to be feared; they are, like the rest of Amonkhet, meant to be healed

events.summary: The fourth stage of the Ghirapur Grand Prix passed through the Broken Lands, where signs of the Chitin Court's approach appeared.
events.quote: The fourth stage of the seconds Ghirapur Grand Prix takes the racers through the Broken Lands.
